scientific_integrity: Exactly one rigorously proved analytic result; finite arithmetic checks are supplemental and not a proof of universality. Earlier qualitative transmission-dependent peak-day bifurcations and exponential-escape frameworks are prior art.
scientific_limitations: A fixed well-mixed exponential-escape SIR map, one initial condition, half-period removal and a bounded transmission interval; no stochastic-network claims, global full-parameter classification or policy effect.
title: A unique peak-day transition and sharp jump in an exponential-escape discrete SIR model
